current_affairs.title: High-Level Committee Report on 'One Nation, One Election'
current_affairs.gs_paper: GS Paper 2: Indian Constitution, Polity, and Governance
current_affairs.summary: The High-Level Committee on Simultaneous Elections submitted recommendations for conducting concurrent polls to the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies, followed by synchronized local body elections within 100 days.
key_takeaways: Requires constitutional amendments to Articles 83, 172, and 356.
Aims to reduce election expenditure, minimize governance disruption, and reduce administrative burden.
Concerns raised regarding impact on federalism and regional party visibility.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Electoral reforms, Constitutional Amendment process, Federal structure dynamics.

current_affairs.title: National Green Hydrogen Mission and SIGHT Program Implementation
current_affairs.gs_paper: GS Paper 3: Infrastructure, Energy, and Environment
current_affairs.summary: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) rolled out implementation guidelines under the Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition (SIGHT) scheme to boost domestic electrolyser manufacturing and green hydrogen production.
key_takeaways: Target to achieve 5 MMT annual Green Hydrogen production by 2030.
Incentives provided for local production of electrolysers.
Supports India's target of Net-Zero emissions by 2070.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Renewable energy targets, climate change mitigation, industrial decarbonization.

current_affairs.title: India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) Strategic Progress
current_affairs.gs_paper: GS Paper 2: International Relations and Bilateral Groupings
current_affairs.summary: Strategic discussions continue on operationalizing the IMEC network involving India, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, the EU, and the US, aiming to enhance connectivity and resilient supply chains across Eurasia.
key_takeaways: Comprises Eastern corridor (India to Arabian Gulf) and Northern corridor (Gulf to Europe).
Includes railway lines, ship-to-rail transit networks, hydrogen pipelines, and high-speed data cables.
Positions India as a key hub in global value chains, serving as a strategic counterweight to China's BRI.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Geopolitics, global supply chains, connectivity corridors, trade infrastructure.

current_affairs.title: Great Nicobar Island Development Project and Environmental Impact Assessment
current_affairs.gs_paper: GS Paper 3: Environment, Biodiversity, and Security
current_affairs.summary: The mega ₹72,000-crore infrastructure project on Great Nicobar Island involving an International Transshipment Terminal, airport, power plant, and township faces ongoing scrutiny regarding ecological impact and tribal protection.
key_takeaways: Project located near Galathea Bay National Park and Campbell Bay National Park.
Impacts endemic fauna and indigenous Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) like the Shompen.
Strategic defense imperative versus ecological and indigenous rights balance.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA), biodiversity vs development, tribal rights, strategic island infrastructure.

current_affairs.title: National Deep Tech Startup Policy (NDTSP) Framework
current_affairs.gs_paper: GS Paper 3: Science and Technology, Economy
current_affairs.summary: The government finalized key strategies under the National Deep Tech Startup Policy to nurture startups working on breakthrough technologies like Artificial Intelligence, Quantum Computing, and Biotechnology.
key_takeaways: Focuses on intellectual property rights (IPR) creation, long-term patient capital funding, and shared R&D infrastructure.
Aims to bridge the gap between academic research and commercial technology deployment.
Addresses data privacy, ethical AI adoption, and dual-use technological challenges.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Indigenous technology development, R&D funding, technology transfer, economic innovation ecosystem.
